build_foldable_tree_node: build a foldable tree node with label, contents, and optional expand state for interactive rendering
build_one_line_tree_node: build a single-line tree node with optional path copy button and background styling
build_custom_foldable_tree_node: build a custom foldable tree node where label handles expand/collapse and contents stay inert
build_field_children: build field children from a dataclass for rendering its attributes as tree nodes
render_dataclass_constructor: render a dataclass constructor call as a foldable tree node with field children
